Mira Vale keeps her ink in a tin that once held salt. She walks the banks before dawn, when the mud still remembers water, and draws the river as it was last year — then, in a thinner line, as it is now.

She lives in [[Ember Reach]], in a kiln-house whose chimney is cold. The [[The Ashwardens|Ashwardens]] asked her for a survey after [[The River Runs Dry]]. Mira said she was already doing it.

She does not carry [[The Last Coal]]. She says a map should not glow. Still, she stops at the lodge on the way home and warms her hands without asking.
